description: This file defines the AdminController class, which handles administrative web requests related to user management such as adding new users. It utilizes Spring MVC annotations and interacts with repository and service layers to perform its operations.

classes.name: AdminController
classes.description: Spring MVC controller managing admin-related web endpoints for user management, including adding users.

methods.name: addUser
methods.description: Handles GET requests to display the form for adding a new user, populating the model with necessary attributes.

methods.name: registerUser
methods.description: Handles POST requests to save a new user, validating input and invoking the user service.
